verdict.rationale: Cua Driver is documented to let an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI, with its own cursor. That is OS-wide app control, not one walled app, and Spaces can host arbitrary signed-in apps such as Chrome or Slack. One community run did type text (in the wrong place), which shows input works but is not always accurate. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of click, type and keyboard-shortcut primitives; independent hands-on evidence of reliable cross-app operation.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent operates desktop applications (click, type, keyboard shortcuts) across the whole OS, not one walled app
